name: pers_ensemble_2026-09-25
objective: maximise 126-session return vs SPY, net of costs
strategy: Only names at least two lenses would pick. Biotech PDUFA sleeve (VRTX, MRK, GILD, ARGX, AGIO, COGT, BBIO, SMMT) is chosen by catalysts plus revision flow: every one has a dated FDA decision or print inside six months and net-positive analyst target actions. Power and semis sleeve (GEV, NVT, ASML, TSM) is chosen by power_grid plus revision flow: inflection flags, double-digit revenue growth, and near-unanimous raises into confirmed October earnings. AME, WST, RGEN are quality-momentum plus revision-flow names. I am wrong if a CRL cluster hits the PDUFA sleeve, or if AI capex digestion cuts semicap orders and grid backlog at once.
